title: Noel Deyzel's account suspension reignites debate over fragrance dupes
summary: The suspension and subsequent restoration of fragrance influencer Noel Deyzel's TikTok and Instagram accounts has reignited tensions between luxury perfume brands and content creators promoting cheaper alternatives. At the heart of the dispute is the distinction between independent fragrance reviews and unfair comparative advertising that may infringe intellectual property rights.
